boy_cries.note: Reviewer SHIP WITH FIXES (fixes applied), avg 7.25, P(1k) 40%. Approved 30 Oct under the 7.0 floor.
text: When a boy cries in front of you, he's not being weak.
He held it in at work, with his friends, in front of his family. You're the first person he let it out with.
He'll wipe his face fast and say sorry. Not because he's embarrassed. Because nobody ever told him it was okay.
He'll go quiet afterwards. Just let him lean on you.
If he's ever cried in front of you... send this to him.
But if you ever bring it up in an argument... he'll never cry in front of you again.
Because when a boy cries in front of you... it means he finally feels safe.

girl_argues.note: Reviewer SHIP WITH FIXES (fixes applied), avg 7.25, P(1k) 40%. Approved 30 Oct under the 7.0 floor.
text: When a girl argues with you, she's not trying to win. She's trying to be understood.
She'll explain the same thing three times. Not because she thinks you're stupid. Because she still believes you'll get it.
She'll cry halfway through a sentence... and keep going anyway.
She'll bring it up again the next morning. Because she'd rather fix it than pretend it didn't happen.
If you still fight for him like this... send this to him.
But the day she stops arguing and just says "okay"... she hasn't calmed down. She's given up.
Because a girl who argues with you... still thinks you're worth the fight.

girl_checks_location.note: Passes the numbers under growth scoring (7.67, 35%) but HELD on purpose: the reviewer flagged brand risk ("tracking your partner = love").
text: When a girl checks your location, she's not spying on you.
She checks it when you're driving home late. Because she can't sleep until the dot stops moving.
She checks it when you don't reply. Not to catch you out. To make sure you're okay.
She'll text "home yet?" even though she can see you are.
If she worries about you like this... send this to the boy she waits up for.
But if you suddenly turn your location off... she won't ask why. She'll already know.
Because a girl who checks your location... just wants you home safe.
When a girl gets jealous, she's not being crazy.
She goes quiet when another girl laughs at your jokes. Not because she doesn't trust you. Because making you laugh is her thing.
She asks who that was... then says "never mind" before you can answer.
She holds your hand a bit tighter when that girl walks past.
If she gets jealous because she's scared of losing you... send this to the boy who never makes her feel silly for it.
But if you enjoy making her jealous... you're not testing her love. You're teaching her to stop caring.
Because a girl who gets jealous... still cares enough to be scared.

girl_steals_hoodie.note: Reviewer SHIP WITH FIXES; line 5 fix and optional line 7 trim applied word for word.
text: When a girl steals your hoodie, she's not just cold.
She wears it when you're away. Because it still smells like you.
She'll swear she's giving it back... and you'll never see it again.
She wears it the night after a fight, even when she's still mad at you.
If your wardrobe is half his hoodies... send this to him.
But the day she gives it back washed and folded... she's not being tidy. She's saying goodbye.
Because a girl in your hoodie... is keeping you close.

man_who_listens.note: Reviewer SHIP WITH FIXES (hook, beat 2 and closing line replaced word for word). Approved 30 Oct under the growth scoring (Reach/Engagement/Relatability avg 7.0) and P(1k) floor 35%. Spec not written yet: the next batch builds it first.
text: A man who really listens remembers the name of the girl at work you can't stand.
He asks if she's still being weird with you, a week later.
He asks how the dentist went, three days later.
He puts his phone face down the second you start a story.
If he listens like this... send this to the girl who deserves it.
But if you have to tell every story twice... he's not tired. He's not interested.
Because a man who listens remembers things you forgot you told him.

girl_leaves_light_on.note: Round 1. SHIP WITH FIXES (lines 1,6 applied). Below 7.0 floor.
text: If she stays up until you're home, she's not checking on you. She just can't sleep until she knows you're safe.
She'll text "drive safe" and then stay awake until you reply you're home.
She'll leave the chain off the door, even after a fight, just in case you still come back.
She'll turn the TV down low so she can hear your key in the lock.
If she waits up like this... send this to the one who makes it home to her.
But the night you pull up and the porch is dark... count how many nights she waited and you never texted back.
Because a girl who leaves the light on... wants you home more than she wants sleep.

boy_never_apologizes_first.note: Round 2 (final round). Reviewer's top pick overall -- closest to the floor (P(1k) meets 35%) but average 6.7 < 7.0 floor. NOT approved; floor not lowered.
text: A boy who never says sorry first isn't too proud to lose an argument.
He'll go quiet for an hour, then show up with your favourite coffee instead of the words.
He'll quietly fix the actual thing you were fighting about, before you even bring it up again.
He'll let you have the last word every single time, because winning matters less to him than you being okay.
If he fixes it like this instead of fighting for the last word... send this to the girl who's stopped keeping score.
But if the coffee keeps showing up and the actual problem never gets fixed... that's not pride. That's avoidance.
Because a boy who never says sorry first... is still trying to make it right. Just not with words.

girl_sleeps_on_your_side.note: Round 2 (final round). Rebuild of the reversed girl_keeps_your_side_of_bed concept. Below 7.0 floor.
text: If she sleeps on your side of the bed when you're away, she's not stealing your spot. It just smells like you.
She'll wear your old t-shirt to bed the whole week you're gone.
She'll hug your pillow instead of hers, then deny it when you call in the morning.
She'll move back to her own side the second you're home, like she was never there.
If she takes over your side like this... send this to the one whose side she keeps stealing.
But if you're gone a whole week and she never once moves to your side... she's not missing you the way she used to.
Because a girl who steals your side of the bed... just wants to feel closer to you.
A boy who stops laughing when his friends joke about you isn't being too sensitive.
He'll go quiet and serious the second someone makes a joke that's actually about you.
He'll bring it up to them later, alone, so you never have to see him do it.
He'll never tell you what they said, because you don't need to carry that.
If he gets protective like this without making a scene... send this to the girl who never has to defend herself.
But the day he laughs along with the joke instead... he's not being chill. He's picked a side, and it isn't yours.
Because a boy who shuts that down... is on your side even when you're not in the room.

boy_fixes_things_quiet.note: Round 2 (final round). Canonical version of boy_fixes_things. Below floor.
text: If he goes quiet and starts fixing something the second you've had a bad day, he's not ignoring you.
He'll tighten the wobbly chair you complained about once, three weeks ago, without a word.
He'll fix the thing that's been bugging you all week instead of asking what's wrong.
He'll check every lock in the house twice before he finally sits back down next to you.
If he shows up like this instead of talking it out... send this to the girl who's learned to read it.
But if the tap's been dripping for a month and he walks right past it... don't wait for him to fix it. Ask him what's wrong.
Because a boy who fixes things when you're upset... is trying to take care of you the only way he knows how.

boy_takes_the_long_way.note: Round 2 (final round). Clean SHIP, no further fixes needed, but below 7.0 floor.
text: If he takes the long way home with you, he's not lost.
He'll add fifteen minutes to the route just so the conversation doesn't end yet.
He'll slow down at the corner where you usually say goodnight, every single time.
He'll say "okay, goodnight" three times at your door and still not leave.
If he stretches the walk home like this... send this to the one who's never in a rush to leave you.
But the night he takes the shortcut and spends the whole walk on his phone... he's not walking you home anymore. He's dropping you off.
Because a boy who takes the long way home... just wants a few more minutes with you.

girl_old_jokes.note: Round 2 (final round). Clean SHIP, no further fixes needed, but below 7.0 floor.
text: If she still laughs at your worst joke after two years, she's not just being nice.
She'll laugh at the one about the goldfish for the hundredth time, like it's the first.
She'll mouth the punchline along with you, and still laugh when you say it.
She'll make you tell it again every time her friends come over.
If she still laughs like this... send this to the one with the worst jokes she's ever loved.
But the day you tell it and she doesn't even look up from her phone... she didn't just stop laughing. She stopped listening.
Because a girl who still laughs at your old jokes... still loves the guy telling them.

girl_saves_your_voice_notes.note: Round 2 (final round). Rewrite of girl_saves_your_voicemails. Below floor.
text: If she replays your voice notes after you've already said goodnight, she's not being clingy.
She'll keep the three-second "call me back" long after you've already called.
She'll play it on the nights you're away, just to fall asleep to your voice instead of the silence.
She'll never delete it, even when she's clearing out everything else on an old phone.
If she keeps your voice like this... send this to the one she misses before he's even left.
But the night your voice note sits there unplayed until morning... ask yourself when she stopped wanting to hear you.
Because a girl who saves your voice notes... wants to hear you even when you're not there.
A girl who always leaves you the last bite isn't full.
She'll leave the last bite of fries every single time, like clockwork.
She'll slide the plate an inch closer to you before you've even asked.
She'll order extra "just in case", and it's never actually for her.
If she saves the last bite like this... send this to the one who's never had to ask for it.
But if she's saved you the last bite for months and you've never once saved her one... start.
Because a girl who leaves you the last bite... is saving the best part for you, every time.

boy_remembers_your_order.note: Round 2 (final round) canonical version. Below floor.
text: A boy who remembers your coffee order after one date isn't just being polite.
He'll order it for you before you even sit down, three dates later.
He'll remember the oat milk, the extra shot, and that you hate it too hot.
He'll hear it's a bad day in how you say hi, and order it black before you even ask.
If he pays attention like this... send this to the girl who's never had to repeat herself.
But the day he has to ask how you take your coffee again... he stopped paying attention a while ago.
Because a boy who remembers your order... remembers you.
